cover.headline: The caps on private equity in sport.

rows.sub: Six-year hold, six teams per fund
Vote over the summer, per FOS

caption:
The caps on private equity in sport.

NFL owners approved Arctos buying 7.5 per cent of the Atlanta Falcons on 20 October, with 2.5 per cent more subject to another vote.

Every US league sets its own limit. The NFL caps a firm at 10 per cent of a team. The NBA, NHL and MLB allow 20 per cent, and MLB has just lifted its limit from 15.

The numbers differ, but the money is passive across all of them.
